depiction.primary_object: three stacked horizontal bars resembling a list or menu
modifiers: large solid circle with an exclamation mark inside at upper right
depiction.composition: three horizontal stripes at bottom left with a circular alert badge cutting into the top two stripes

readings.meaning: error log or system alert list
urgent notification or unread message queue

ambiguity: At small sizes the three bars can read as a stack of coins or server blades with an alert, or as a generic hamburger menu.

modifier_semantics.meaning: warning, error, urgent attention needed, or unread notification

example_tasks.task: Go through the critical errors from last night's batch job
Resolve the three flagged transactions on the Visa statement
Look into the compiler warnings in the auth module
Dismiss stale notifications in the Home Assistant dashboard
Audit the failed webhook deliveries list in Stripe
Check why the NAS keeps throwing disk health warnings
Sort through the high-priority bug reports before standup
Export the full list of 500 errors from CloudWatch for the postmortem doc
Go through the municipal code violation notices and highlight what needs a permit
Clean up the noisy alert rules so the on-call log stays readable

example_tasks_es: Revisar el registro de errores del servidor de producción
Limpiar las notificaciones pendientes en la consola
Atender incidencias urgentes de la lista de soporte
example_tasks_ru: Разобрать лог ошибок после ночного деплоя
Проверить список критических уведомлений в панели

context_tasks.task: Mute noisy Slack channels during on-call shift

near_misses.task: URGENT: buy dog food on the way home
Make a packing list for Lisbon
Check the restaurant menu for gluten-free options
Count stack of poker chips from Friday night
Call the plumber right now about the leak

reasoning: Shows three stacked list/menu bars with a prominent exclamation badge, reading as an error log, alert queue, or list with warnings. It fits tech and admin tasks centered on triaging logs, notifications, or flagged items, though it must not be used merely to mark any ordinary task as 'urgent'.
